title: 3dXClustSim
description: ETAC processing tool to find cluster figure of merit (FOM) thresholds.

hpow.description: H power values (can be a subset of 0, 1, 2). Default is 2.
hpow.title: H power values

ncase.description: Number of cases with labels. Default is 1 A.
ncase.title: Number of cases

pthr.description: List of p-value thresholds. Default is 0.0100 0.0056 0.0031 0.0018 0.0010.
pthr.title: P-value thresholds

fpr.description: Set global FPR goal to an integer ff between 2 and 9. Default is 5.
fpr.title: Global FPR goal

multiFPR.description: Compute results for multiple FPR goals (2%, 3%, ... 9%).
multiFPR.title: Multiple FPR goal

minclust.description: Minimum cluster size in voxels. Default is 5.
minclust.title: Minimum cluster size

nolocal.description: Do not perform voxel-wise ETAC computations.
nolocal.title: No voxel-wise ETAC computations

noglobal.description: Do not perform volume-wise ETAC computations.
noglobal.title: No volume-wise ETAC computations

splitfrac.description: Fraction to split simulations into pieces (0.2 < F < 0.8).
splitfrac.title: Split fraction
